scenarios.test_name: gateway binds a reconnecting initialize request to the pending upstream response
scenarios.expected: one upstream initialize and one replayed alias response

scenarios.test_name: stable request key adopts an in-flight request without duplicate upstream dispatch
scenarios.expected: one upstream request and one adopted request key

scenarios.test_name: unacknowledged delivery replays once and disappears after acknowledgement
server-request response is forwarded upstream at most once
turn completion is continuous both immediately before and after disconnect
scenarios.expected: both completion deliveries replay in sequence

scenarios.test_name: resume token fails closed after gateway process-state loss
scenarios.expected: resume session missing and no silent state recreation

scenarios.test_name: upstream exit is visible and closes only its consumer session
scenarios.expected: explicit backend exit and isolated session close
